decisions.reason: As a multi-item dietary supplement range that clearly fits the firm's consumer-health expansion and pharmacy relationships, it is more likely to be retained than withdrawn.
The skin and hair supplement was actively launched for pharmacy customers and remains a good fit with the firm's OTC and consumer-health portfolio, despite normal competitive pressure in supplements.
The joint-health supplement supports portfolio broadening, but its lower visibility and the crowded nature of this segment make it more review-prone than the firm's stronger consumer-health lines.

Given the earlier valsartan safety issue, strong price pressure in generics, and weaker strategic attractiveness than the firm's branded consumer-health and development activities, management would likely discontinue this product.
An OTC migraine triptan strengthens the firm's higher-value self-medication offering and is likely to be kept if it has cleared its early market-entry phase satisfactorily.
